title: Document session signing (T-0245 round A)
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-document; a real PDF signs with the PFX fixture, saves, reopens in PDFium with unchanged pages/text, verify_signature is Valid and bytes_match, and a one-byte tamper after signing reports Tampered
notes: Library half of T-0245 split out because the app lane cannot edit pdfxi-document. Adds the ADR 0010 session sign path: call pdfxi_security::pdf_signature::sign_pdf on the session document, keep the original bytes as the exact prefix plus one incremental revision, update the before/after digests and revision list, clear redo. Tests use the real fixture and crates/pdfxi-security/tests/fixtures/pfx/leaf-aes256.pfx (password pdfxi-test-pfx): open, sign, save, reopen with PDFium (page count and text unchanged), verify_signature (Valid, bytes_match, covers_entire_file), then flip one byte after signing and assert Tampered. The app Sign panel and E-signed badge remain T-0245 round B.
